battery-ventures._readme: Identity merges for Battery. Two sources of duplication dominate and both come from the firm's own surfaces. (1) The compliance list publishes REGISTERED names while the portfolio page publishes trading names, so the same company appears twice: 'eShares, Inc. (dba Carta)' and 'Carta', 'APIHub' and 'Clearbit', 'Appboy' and 'Braze'. Read the other way round this is a gift -- it is how the renames were discovered at all. (2) Battery's own spelling drift across captures: 'XtremlO' with a lowercase L for XtremIO, 'SensSage', 'OptoAtmoshperics', 'Galilleo', 'Burbury & Hicks', 'Vantage Analysis Sytems'. Canonical is the rendering on the firm's own portfolio page where one exists.
